caption: The drawing depicts two objects: an open book and a single page of text, both arranged on a plain, light-colored background. The book is shown closed and lying at an angle in the lower portion of the composition; its cover is dark brown with a mottled, worn texture, and the spine and edges show signs of age and use, with lighter, almost beige highlights along the book’s edges and corners. The book has a rectangular form, and its thickness and substantial appearance are emphasized. Above the book, a single page is oriented so that its text is easily readable. This page is off-white or tan, with a slight aged stain or shadowing, and contains black printed text in various sizes, with “ENGLISH GRAMMAR” and “A COMPENDIUM” being particularly prominent among the details visible on the page. The drawing is realistic in style, providing clear depiction of the color, material, and physical state of both the book and the page.
title: Book - English Grammar
